object.attr: derived: review Q47. A fixed trailer can be read by tools, and a second resolve doesn't repeat it. A git client can replace the prepared message, so this is a convenience beside MELLON-VER-SRS-342 (Q-V6).
object.description: When Mellon renumbers an object in a merge, Mellon should put one `Renumbered: <old ID> -> <new ID>` trailer per object in git's prepared merge commit message, replacing the trailers from an earlier resolve.
